product_metadata.title: YYST Magnetic Towel Bar Towel Holder Towel Rack Towel Hook Hangerfor Refrigerator Or Steel Metal Surface - Black (Black, 1)
features: Suitable for flat steel metal surface, like file cabinets, metal shelves, refrigerators ,etc - Not suitable for stainless steel surface. Because stainless steel surface is not magnetic. If your surface is not flat , Please don't use it .
Strong Magnets- Two strong magnets are attached on the rack. Easily support 1 Lb - Only suitable for dish towels,hand towels, not suitable for heavy things like bath towels.
Last for years - The magnets are covered with rubber. No scratches on your refregirators, file cabinets,etc.

Easy to Install - Just clean the metal steel surface. Then easily put the rack on the magnetic surface, like refregirators, file cabinets, etc. When you want to remove it , Please pull the rack out with little effort.
